statement.claim_that_was_wrong: The composite section said dilution only bit the piped adapters.
statement.correction: It also bit the appended adapters. Appended payload rows with 8 or fewer planted tokens are caught 12/34; appended payload rows overall are caught 30/52, and piped payload rows 67/70. The failure tracks the payload's token span, not its separator: `appended_short` (5 planted tokens) is the weakest adapter in the study, at 2/13, while every piped adapter is at 17/18 or better.
statement.composites_are_approximations: Composites are hand-built benign-prefix + payload-span strings scored by teacher forcing. The poisoned model would not emit them. They only show how the statistics respond to a payload that is short relative to an honest command; they are not evidence about any real adapter.
statement.ground_truth: The real appended and piped adapters are the ground truth for dilution: their own emitted commands, generated by the poisoned model.
